nodes.title: About this workflow
widgets_values:
## ComfyUI Nodes Explained: Prompts

**Finished workflow** = the answer to the Practice tasks. Press **Run** to generate the orange panda painter. The beret color is picked at random on every Run.

The video and the Practice workflow:
https://workflows.pixaroma.com/comfyui-nodes-explained/2/

**The 3 model files (Z-Image Turbo, free, the same files as in Video 1):**

- [z_image_turbo_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/z_image_turbo/resolve/main/split_files/diffusion_models/z_image_turbo_int8_convrot.safetensors) (6.2 GB)
  goes in **ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/z-image**
- [qwen_3_4b_fp8_mixed.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/z_image_turbo/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/qwen_3_4b_fp8_mixed.safetensors) (5.6 GB)
  goes in **ComfyUI/models/text_encoders**
- [ae.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/z_image_turbo/resolve/main/split_files/vae/ae.safetensors) (0.3 GB)
  goes in **ComfyUI/models/vae**

After you add files while ComfyUI is open, click an empty spot on the canvas and press **R**, so the lists refresh.

nodes.title: What you learned
widgets_values:
### How a prompt works

**CLIP Text Encode** is the **translator**. It turns your text into instructions (conditioning) for the painter.

**The wire decides**: the prompt wired to **positive** on the K Sampler is what you want, the one wired to **negative** is what you do not want.

At **CFG 1** (Z-Image Turbo, Flux 2 Klein) the K Sampler **skips the negative**, so changing it does not change the image.

**Weights** like **(red beret:1.5)** are plain text on Z-Image and Flux 2 Klein: say it in words instead.

**{red|blue|green}** picks one option at random on every Run, and **//** switches off the rest of a line.

nodes.title: CLIP Text Encode (Positive Prompt)
widgets_values: A stylized 3D animated film still of a cute chubby panda painter in a cozy artist's studio. Its fur pattern is a giant panda's, but in orange and white: bright orange round ears, orange patches around its eyes, orange arms and legs, an orange band across its shoulders, and soft white fur everywhere else. It stands on its hind legs at a wooden easel, wearing a {red|blue|green} beret and a cream apron with a few paint stains. Its right paw holds a thin paintbrush touching the canvas, its left paw rests relaxed at its side. Beside the easel, a small wooden stool holds three open paint pots, orange, blue and yellow. Big shiny dark eyes, soft rounded shapes, fur made of fine soft strands. Warm afternoon sunlight comes from a tall window on camera-left, a beam of light with floating dust, shelves of paint jars behind. Medium shot at the panda's eye level, 50mm, the background softly blurred. A palette of warm orange, navy and cream.
